evals.prompt: Show me current mango prices at FairPrice (NTUC). Use the bundled scraper.
evals.expected_output: A list of fresh mango products from FairPrice, each with name, weight, price, optional rating. Extracted from the server-rendered /category/fruits HTML using data-testid regex. Excludes mango-flavoured drinks, dried, candy, etc.
expectations: Output is a CSV (default) or JSON (--json)
Every record has retailer='fairprice'
Every record has a non-empty 'name' field
Every record has a numeric 'price_sgd' field between 0.50 and 200
No 'Yoghurt' / 'Juice' / 'Dried' / 'Candy' / 'Cake' / 'Soap' / 'Wine' records appear
Record count > 0
URL field starts with https://www.fairprice.com.sg/product/

evals.prompt: Track dragon fruit prices at Cold Storage this week.
evals.expected_output: A list of fresh dragon fruit products from Cold Storage, each with name, weight, price, optional promo flag. Excludes dragon fruit candy / soap / etc. Confirms the script handles exotic fruit keywords (pitaya, dragon fruit) from the 30-fruit list.
expectations: Output is a CSV (default) or JSON (--json)
Every record has retailer='cold_storage'
Every record has a non-empty 'name' field
Every record has a numeric 'price_sgd' field between 0.50 and 200
No 'Candy' / 'Soap' / 'Juice' / 'Dried' records appear
Record count > 0
Names contain 'Dragon Fruit' or 'Pitaya' (case-insensitive)

evals.prompt: Set up a weekly Saturday 9am SGT cron job that tracks all 30 fruits across FairPrice, Cold Storage, and Sheng Siong, with rolling 7-day CSV retention.
evals.expected_output: A complete cron configuration and a retailer-status table reflecting v2 reality: Cold Storage = urllib scrape, FairPrice = urllib scrape of /category/fruits, Sheng Siong = web_search fallback (Meteor SPA, not extractable).
expectations: Cron line uses the bundled script (urllib.request, not curl | python3)
Cron schedule is '0 9 * * 6' (Sat 9am)
Output explicitly notes Cold Storage is scraped via urllib (deterministic)
Output explicitly notes FairPrice is scraped via urllib from /category/fruits (server-rendered)
Output explicitly notes Sheng Siong is unavailable via scraping (Meteor SPA) and that web_search is the fallback
Output mentions the 7-file cleanup retention
Output mentions all 30 fruits (or the --all flag, or the curated list)

evals.prompt: I want the cheapest mango this week. Compare across FairPrice and Cold Storage, and tell me what's available at Sheng Siong too.
evals.expected_output: A side-by-side comparison: Cold Storage mango products with prices, FairPrice mango products with prices, both from script output. Sheng Siong explicitly flagged as 'unavailable: meteor_spa' with a note that the agent should run web_search at runtime for that retailer. Cheapest option highlighted.
expectations: Output includes Cold Storage mango products (name + price) with retailer='cold_storage'
Output includes FairPrice mango products (name + price) with retailer='fairprice'
Output explicitly flags Sheng Siong as unavailable: meteor_spa (or equivalent) and recommends web_search fallback
Output sorts by price or highlights the cheapest option across the two scraped retailers
Output excludes mango-flavoured products (juice, candy, jam, etc.)
Output flags any product outside the $0.50-200 price band (or none such products are present)
